narration: Have you ever wondered why the sky is blue on a clear day?
visual: Max stands on a grassy hill looking up at a wide open sky with a few clouds

narration: Sunlight looks white, but it is really a mix of every color of the rainbow, all travelling together.
visual: A beam of sunlight splits through a prism into a rainbow fan of colors

narration: Air molecules scatter short blue waves far more than red ones, so blue reaches your eyes from every direction.
visual: Max points at small blue arrows bouncing off tiny air molecules toward his eyes
